## Case Studies
- [Admizz Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/admizz-case-study/): How Admizz Education reduced student-inquiry response time by 45% and tripled satisfaction with Zunkiree Search's AI-native inquiry system.

- [Khushbu Nirman Sewa Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/khushbu-nirman-case-study/): How a Kathmandu construction company cut project delays by 40% and saved NPR 2.5 crore with AI-powered project tracking and predictive delay alerts.
- [Rapid Investment Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/rapid-investment-case-study/): How Rapid Investment Group analyzes investment opportunities 10x faster with Zunkiree's AI-powered due-diligence research synthesis.
- [CMS Group Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/cms-group-case-study/): How CMS Group automated 85% of its enterprise document processing workflows with Zunkiree's AI classification and routing systems.
- [Mach24 Orbital Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/mach24orbital-case-study/): How Mach24 Orbital cut satellite launch preparation time in half with Zunkiree's AI-unified readiness and conflict-detection systems.
- [Prime Tiles Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/prime-tiles-case-study/): How Prime Tiles doubled its online conversion rate with Zunkiree Search's AI-native, natural-language product search.
- [Khems Cleaning Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/khems-cleaning-case-study/): How Khems Cleaning Services increased bookings by 70% with Zunkiree's AI-powered automated scheduling and cancellation backfill.
- [Chayce Properties Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/chayce-properties-case-study/): How Zunkiree Labs runs the full digital operation for Chayce Properties, a UK real estate company — website, AI systems, and ongoing technical delivery under one partner.
- [Dental AI Assistant Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/dental-ai-case-study/): Dental AI Assistant is Zunkiree Labs' in-progress product for dental practices, currently running in private beta. This case study covers why we're building it, the AI approach behind it, and what's shipped so far ahead of general availability.
- [Stella Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/stella-case-study/): Stella is Zunkiree Labs' AI commerce agent, built to carry shoppers from discovery through checkout without a human or a script in the loop. This case study covers why we built it, the engineering decisions behind it, and what shipped.
- [Zennly Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/zenly-case-study/): Zennly is Zunkiree Labs' AI-powered scheduling engine, built to handle multi-provider, multi-resource availability that a plain calendar can't represent. This case study covers the engineering behind automatic conflict resolution and no-show reduction.
- [Zennly](https://zennly.io/): Multi-branch booking and operations software for spas, salons, gyms and clinics in Nepal, built by Zunkiree Labs.
- [Gaamma Case Study](https://zunkireelabs.com/resources/gaamma-case-study/): Gaamma is Zunkiree Labs' manufacturing ERP, built to unify production planning, inventory, and quality control with AI-driven predictive maintenance. This case study covers why we built it and how it plugs into equipment already on the floor.

## Locations
Zunkiree Labs serves businesses in four Nepal locations from its Sanepa, Lalitpur headquarters. Each city page links to nine service pages. Index: https://zunkireelabs.com/locations/
- [Lalitpur: Zunkiree Labs](https://zunkireelabs.com/locations/lalitpur/): Zunkiree Labs is headquartered in Sanepa, Lalitpur (Patan), just minutes from Kathmandu. Our team of AI engineers and software developers builds production-grade AI systems for businesses across Nepal and globally.
- [Bhaktapur: Zunkiree Labs](https://zunkireelabs.com/locations/bhaktapur/): Zunkiree Labs serves Bhaktapur's business community from our headquarters in Sanepa, Lalitpur, within the Kathmandu Valley. We work with local enterprises seeking AI and digital transformation.
- [Pokhara: Zunkiree Labs](https://zunkireelabs.com/locations/pokhara/): Zunkiree Labs serves clients in Pokhara, Nepal's second-largest city, through remote collaboration from our headquarters in Sanepa, Lalitpur. We've worked with tourism, hospitality, and local businesses in the Pokhara region.
